QF.id: Registration, Code of Conduct and General Obligations_52

question.text: A merchant banker delays the payment of its registration renewal fee by 4 months. If the renewal fee is Rs. 9,00,000 (payable every three years from the sixth year), what is the approximate late fee payable at 15% per annum?

explanation.text: The Logic: Late fee is 15% per annum for each month of delay or part thereof, applied to the fee amount. For a 4-month delay on Rs. 9,00,000: Rs. 9,00,000 x 15% x (4/12) = Rs. 45,000. The Trap: Applying 15% for a full year (Rs. 1,35,000) or half year (Rs. 67,500) ignores that the rate is pro-rated for the actual months of delay. The workbook fee basis is Rs. 20 lakh registration and Rs. 9 lakh renewal every three years from the sixth year, not a Rs. 5 lakh annual fee. Note: Use the workbook fee figures (Rs. 20 lakh registration, Rs. 9 lakh renewal) when computing the 15% per annum late fee.
